instructions_to_main_agent: Build CalcolaPro in frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx (or separate modular components under frontend/src/components/calculator/).
Set the font family in frontend/src/index.css using @import '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans'; and @import '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans'; and @import '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono';
Use Recharts (already preinstalled in template) for either a Donut PieChart or BarChart showing the breakdown: Costo Prodotto, Commissioni Piattaforma, Spedizione & Packaging, Tasse, Guadagno Netto.

Formulas: (1) Total Platform Fee = (Sale Price * Platform% / 100) + Platform Fixed Fee. (2) Gross Margin = Sale Price - Purchase Cost - Shipping Cost - Packaging Cost - Platform Fee. (3) Taxes = Gross Margin > 0 ? (Gross Margin * Tax Rate / 100) : 0. (4) Net Profit = Gross Margin - Taxes. (5) Margin % = (Net Profit / Sale Price) * 100. (6) ROI / Ritorno sull'investimento % = (Net Profit / (Purchase Cost + Shipping Cost + Packaging Cost)) * 100.
Italian number formatting: Format all inputs and outputs using Italian locale (e.g. 1.250,00 € or 12,50 €). Support typing commas or dots.

Copy Summary Button: Formats a clean Italian summary (Prezzo di vendita, Costi, Commissioni, Guadagno Netto, Margine %) and copies to navigator.clipboard. Show toast('Riepilogo calcolo copiato negli appunti!').

Section 2 ('Preventivi & P.IVA') & Section 3 ('Rendita Affitti Brevi') should render as high-polish elegant previews with 'In arrivo a breve' badges, feature highlights (e.g. Scorporo IVA, Calcolo Fattura Elettronica, Cedolare Secca 21% vs 26%, Tassa di Soggiorno), and notification signup form placeholder.

Affiliate Box: Render prominently under results with 'Risparmia sulle spedizioni e gestisci i tuoi incassi' with two distinct, high-contrast action cards/buttons for courier comparison and 0-fee business banking.
Verify all data-testid attributes match the specified list for automated regression testing.
